description: Compare two areas in England or Wales side by side on median sold price and its change, income, population, private renters, deprivation, flood risk, broadband, council tax and (when both are current) the live listings pulse and live asking rents. Each line says which area is higher and by how much. Each input can be a postcode, a postcode district or a place name. Two local authority names (for example Leeds and Manchester) are compared as authorities, each as the postcode districts that sit mostly inside it, and the result says so. England & Wales only.

area_a.description: First area. A postcode ("E17 7AB"), postcode district ("E17") or place name ("Walthamstow", "Hackney")
